verdict.rationale: The only evidence of official SDKs is a glancing line in Stripe's llms.txt about installing Stripe packages from npm. Identity docs show only curl calls to the REST API, and the published OpenAPI spec is a building block for generating clients, not an official SDK itself. missing for 10: explicit documentation of official Identity-capable SDKs and their supported languages, SDK code examples for verification sessions, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use with Identity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: When installing Stripe packages, always check the npm registry for the latest version
